    s33 = 0x3333333333333333  # mask with 2 bits set to 1 in each nibble
    s0F = 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F  # mask with last 4 bits set to 1 in each byte

    # KC-10: Subtract from each element in the array half of itself bitwise ANDed with a mask `s55`.
    arr = [x - ((x >> 1) & s55) for x in arr]

    # KC-11: use mask `s33` to combine partial sums from pairs to 4-bit nibbles.
    arr = [x - ((x >> 2) & s33) for x in arr]

    # KC-12: Add to each element its version right-shifted by 4 bits to aggregate counts from 4-bit nibbles to 8-bit bytes.
    arr = [x + (x >> 4) for x in arr]

    # KC-13: use mask `s0F` to keep only the lower 4 bits of each byte, preventing overflow.
    arr = [x & s0F for x in arr]

    return arr
